summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing for Munesh Properties MVP. Backend: 23/23 pytest tests passed covering /meta, /properties (list/get/filter/search/404), /contact, /enquiries (public POST), auth (login success/fail, /me guard), admin CRUD for properties, admin contact update, admin enquiries list/delete, and media upload+/api/files serving via Emergent Object Storage. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): home feed loads 8 seeded properties, category chips (Plots) and location chips (Aligarh) filter correctly, search input works, tapping a card opens the details screen showing gallery, price, description, amenities and the persistent bottom CTA row (WhatsApp/Call/Enquiry). Enquiry form submits and shows the 'Enquiry Sent!' success state. Contact screen renders all 4 channels (WhatsApp/Call/Telegram/Email) plus areas served. Admin login with Munesh2006/Aditya198@# succeeds, all 3 dashboard tabs (Listings/Enquiries/Settings) render, add-property FAB navigates to /admin/property-form, contact settings inputs and save button render. No React Native red screen. No deprecated Expo packages (no expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch).

issues: Console warnings from RN Web: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated (use boxShadow) and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated'. Non-blocking but should be cleaned up in theme.shadow.card and any pointerEvents usage.

action_items: Optional: Migrate theme shadow.card from RN Web 'shadow*' props to 'boxShadow' to silence deprecation warnings on web preview.
Optional: Replace any legacy 'pointerEvents' prop usage with style.pointerEvents to silence deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py PropertyBase.status/featured/media come with defaults; PUT /admin/properties uses PropertyCreate (all fields required in UI). Consider a Partial/Update model for future partial edits.
ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH is computed at every process start (bcrypt) - fine but any restart re-hashes; not a bug.
GET /files/{path} returns 404 for any storage error including transient 5xx from object store; consider distinguishing 404 vs 502.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. Tests create TEST_-prefixed data and clean up (property create+delete, enquiry create+delete, contact update+restore).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend uses fixed admin (env ADMIN_USERNAME/ADMIN_PASSWORD) with JWT. Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_munesh_api.py — it exercises every endpoint end-to-end and cleans up. Frontend testIDs to know: category-chip-{plot|home|land|shop|all}, location-chip-{name|all}, search-input, properties-list, property card testIDs are 'property-card-*', property detail CTAs are cta-whatsapp/cta-call/cta-enquiry (NOT detail-*), enquiry-{name|phone|email|message}-input, enquiry-submit-button, contact-{whatsapp|call|telegram|email}-button, admin-username-input/admin-password-input/admin-login-button, admin-tab-{properties|enquiries|settings}, add-property-fab, contact-{whatsapp|phone|telegram|email|address|about}-input, save-contact-button.
